purpose: Synthetic target-fit launch visualization; not a motor selection or flight prediction.

inputs.status: Representative unverified simulation inputs; not properties of a normal IREC rocket.

model.translation: 1-D vertical point mass; constant thrust during linear propellant burn; quadratic drag; exponential atmosphere; RK4 integration.
model.post_apogee: Ballistic for 1 s, then instantaneous CdA=8 m^2 parachute model for 6 s.
model.attitude: Illustrative only and independent of translation: roll ramps to 0.2 rev/s; tilt is limited to 6 deg.
sources: Free-space path loss and kTB receiver screening equations

video_radio.range_basis: The radio design target remains 10 km slant range and is independent of trajectory apogee.
video_radio.waveform: DVB-S2 QPSK 2/3 normal frames with pilots at 8 MSym/s
video_radio.warning: Receiver threshold and installed antenna pattern are assumed, not measured; margin is illustrative.
